title: [Discord surface (4) extract the mention router](20)[REFACTOR: Extract Function] routePlanningMention -> core/mention-router.ts
description:
## Summary

`routePlanningMention` in `core/mention-router.ts` now does three steps `handlePlanningMention` did inline. Slack behaves exactly as before.

It parses the lobby mention, asks `choosePlanningRoute` for the decision, and works out whether to warn that the auto tag cannot apply here.

`handlePlanningMention` calls it once and keeps every Slack call, including posting that warning.

## Review Claim

Extract Function: parsing, the pre-repo decision, and the auto-tag warning check in `SlackSurface.handlePlanningMention` move into `routePlanningMention` in `packages/surfaces/src/core/mention-router.ts`, with Slack behavior unchanged.

## Review Lane

refactor

## Review Unit

ownership-refactor

## Safety Invariant

Slack behavior is unchanged. `routePlanningMention` calls the same `parsePlanningRequest` and `choosePlanningRoute` with the same arguments, and computes the notice flag with the same test the inline code used. The existing Slack test suite passes with no test file edited.

## Slice Rationale

One extraction per PR. This gives a second chat surface a single entry point for the pre-repo half of the lobby decision, and it sits on top of the `choosePlanningRoute` PR it wraps.

## Non-goals

- Behavior unchanged: no Slack message text changes.
- No change to the five-step repo precedence; repo resolution stays in `SlackSurface`.
- No parser rewrite.
- No Discord code.
- No test file edited.

> [!NOTE]
> **Low Risk**
> Pure refactor with identical parse/route/warning logic; Slack messaging and repo resolution paths are unchanged.
> 
> **Overview**
> **Extracts lobby planning @user routing** into `routePlanningMention` in `core/mention-router.ts`, alongside the existing workflow router.
> 
> The new helper takes a surface-neutral `MentionMessage` plus `MentionRoutingContext`, runs `parsePlanningRequest` and `choosePlanningRoute`, and returns a `PlanningMention` object with `parsed`, `route`, and `announceAutoSubmitUnavailable` (same boolean logic as before). `SlackSurface.handlePlanningMention` calls it once and still owns all Slack replies, including the auto-submit warning.
> 
> Adds `MentionMessage` and `PlanningMention` types so another chat surface can share the pre–repo-resolution lobby decision without duplicating Slack code.
